item.title: Iran Airstrikes Push Gas to $2.99; K-State Economist Warns Prices Could Near $4
item.description: Gas prices have jumped after airstrikes in Iran, reaching an average of $2.99 a gallon both nationally and at local gas stations Casey’s, Jump Start and Dillon’s Gas Stations according to Gas Buddy March 2 .

item.title: McPherson voters approve both USD 418 bond questions
item.description: McPHERSON — Voters in the McPherson Public Schools USD 418 community approved an $89.5 million bond package Tuesday, authorizing a series of facility upgrades and renovations across the district.

item.title: Peabody Teacher arrested for sexual misconduct
item.description: PEABODY — A Hesston man and teacher at Peabody-Burns High School was arrested March 3 following an investigation into alleged sexual contact with a student, according to the Marion County Sheriff’s Office.

item.title: Kansas Senate measure imposes fines on school districts tied to student walkouts
item.description: TOPEKA — The Kansas Senate voted Tuesday to clamp down on public school protests by requiring students to secure parental permission to participate and by imposing penalties on districts complicit in organizing protests or meek in disciplining student offenders.

item.title: Children’s Choir hosts fundraiser
item.description: The Newton Community Children’s Choir will hosted a talent show and dessert auction March 1 at Bethel College Mennonite Church, 2600 College Ave. The evening featured performances by choir members, and some parents, along with a silent auction of desserts donated by local bakers. All photos by Michele Clark/Newton Kansan
